title: Backups
description: Create and manage server backups to protect your data. Schedule automated backups, download existing ones, and restore when needed.
description_extended: Create and manage server backups to protect your data. Schedule automated backups, download existing ones, and restore when needed. Backups are deduplicated, meaning unchanged files are only stored once across all backups
backup_name_description: If provided, the name that should be used to reference this backup.
ignored_files_modal_description: Enter the files or folders to ignore while generating this backup. Leave blank to use the contents of the .pyroignore file in the root of the server directory if present. Wildcard matching of files and folders is supported in addition to negating a rule by prefixing the path with an exclamation point.
locked_description: Prevents this backup from being deleted until explicitly unlocked.
password_required_delete_all: Password is required to delete all backups.
all_backups_deleting: All backups and repositories are being deleted. This may take a few minutes.
password_required_delete_bulk: Password is required to delete backups.
bulk_delete_success: {{count}} backup{{count, plural, one { is} other {s are}}} being deleted.
delete_all_warning: You are about to permanently delete <1>{{count}} backup{{count, plural, one {} other {s}}}</1> and completely destroy the backup repository for this server.
delete_all_item_1: All backup data will be permanently deleted
delete_all_item_2: Locked backups will also be deleted
delete_all_item_3: The entire backup repository will be destroyed
delete_all_item_4: This operation may take several minutes to complete
delete_all_item_5: You will not be able to restore any of these backups
delete_selected_warning: You are about to permanently delete <1>{{count}} backup{{count, plural, one {} other {s}}}</1>. This action cannot be undone.
delete_selected_description: The selected backup files and their snapshots will be permanently deleted.
cannot_create: Backups cannot be created for this server.
create_one_to_start: Your server does not have any backups. Create one to get started.
password_required_delete: Password is required to delete this backup.
password_required_restore: Password is required to restore this backup.
unlock_description: This backup will no longer be protected from automated or accidental deletions.
restore_description: Your server will be stopped during the restoration process. You will not be able to control the power state, access the file manager, or create additional backups until completed.
restore_destructive_description: All current files and server configuration will be deleted and replaced with the backup data. This action cannot be undone.
delete_permanent: This is a permanent operation. The backup cannot be recovered once deleted.
delete_warning_description: The backup file and its snapshot will be permanently deleted.
